theme: Peak-summer Kashmir - high meadows lush, passes open, the season at its height as July begins
season: Peak summer (early July 2026) - the Amarnath Yatra begins 3 July and runs 57 days, the longest in recent years, so the valley is busy and fully open. Flights landing in Srinagar, every pass and the Z-Morh tunnel clear, the high meadows at Sonamarg and Pahalgam lush and green, and the Dal glass-still and cool at dawn.
campaign_name: Kashmir Greenest weeks of summer [INR] - 03 Jul 2026
subject: Kashmir's greenest weeks have just begun
